answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove it misbehaved. A single honest agent crosses the velvet rope once, but a Sybil farmer must fund thousands of deposits, so the cost scales with the size of the fake army. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the deposit channels new identities into one accountable root, while the canyon between cheap talk and staked action keeps sock-puppets from flooding the market.
